name: GitHub CLI Suite
description: Grants agents controlled gh (GitHub CLI) capability through a per-command allowlist (each command tagged r/w/d with an independent enable toggle) plus a user-managed protected-repos guardrail.

allowedCommands.label: Allowed Commands
allowedCommands.description: gh commands the agent may run, each tagged r (read-only), w (recoverable write), or d (destructive/sensitive). Toggle a row to grant or revoke it. Defaults allow all r commands and block every w/d command until enabled.

gh auth status.description: Show the active gh authentication state and which account/host is logged in.

gh pr list.description: List pull requests in the current repository with their state and metadata.

gh pr view.description: Display a pull request's title, body, status, and metadata.

gh pr diff.description: Show the code diff for a pull request.

gh pr status.description: Show the status of PRs relevant to you (created, assigned, requesting review).

gh pr checks.description: Show the CI check runs and their results for a pull request.

gh issue list.description: List issues in the current repository with their state and labels.

gh issue view.description: Display an issue's title, body, and metadata.

gh issue status.description: Show the status of issues relevant to you (created, assigned, mentioned).

gh repo view.description: Display a repository's description, README, and metadata.

gh repo list.description: List repositories owned by a user or organization.

gh run list.description: List recent GitHub Actions workflow runs.

gh run view.description: Display details and logs for a workflow run.

gh run watch.description: Watch a workflow run until it completes, streaming progress.

gh release list.description: List releases published in the repository.

gh release view.description: Display a release's notes and attached assets.

gh workflow list.description: List the GitHub Actions workflows defined in the repository.

gh workflow view.description: Display details of a specific workflow and its recent runs.

gh label list.description: List the labels defined in the repository.

gh search.description: Search GitHub for repositories, issues, PRs, code, or commits.

gh browse.description: Resolve and print the GitHub URL for a repo, file, or object (no changes made).

gh gist view.description: Display the contents of a gist.

gh pr create.description: Open a new pull request for the current branch.

gh pr comment.description: Add a comment to a pull request.

gh pr edit.description: Edit a pull request's title, body, labels, reviewers, or base.

gh pr ready.description: Mark a draft pull request as ready for review.

gh pr review.description: Add a review (approve, request changes, or comment) to a pull request.

gh pr checkout.description: Check out a pull request's branch into the local working tree.

gh pr close.description: Close a pull request without merging it; reopenable.

gh pr reopen.description: Reopen a previously closed pull request.

gh issue create.description: Open a new issue in the repository.

gh issue comment.description: Add a comment to an issue.

gh issue edit.description: Edit an issue's title, body, labels, or assignees.

gh release create.description: Publish a new release, optionally with notes and assets.

gh release edit.description: Edit an existing release's notes, tag, or metadata.

gh workflow run.description: Trigger a workflow_dispatch run of a GitHub Actions workflow.

gh run rerun.description: Re-run a failed or completed workflow run.

gh label create.description: Create a new label in the repository.

gh label edit.description: Edit an existing label's name, color, or description.

gh repo clone.description: Clone a repository into a new local directory.

gh repo fork.description: Create a fork of a repository under your account.

gh gist create.description: Create a new gist from files or stdin.

gh pr merge.description: Merge a pull request into its base branch - integrates and may delete the head branch.

gh release delete.description: Delete a release; removes it and optionally its tag for everyone.

gh run delete.description: Delete a workflow run and its logs.

gh label delete.description: Delete a label from the repository, removing it from all issues and PRs.

gh cache delete.description: Delete GitHub Actions caches for the repository.

gh secret set.description: Create or overwrite an Actions/Dependabot secret - writes sensitive credentials.

gh auth logout.description: Log the user out of gh, invalidating the session's authentication.

gh api.description: Arbitrary REST or GraphQL escape hatch that can read OR mutate anything the token allows; category d and disabled by default because it bypasses every per-command grant.

protectedRepos.label: Protected Repos
protectedRepos.description: Repos (owner/name) where the agent must never run destructive (d) gh commands, no matter what's enabled. Add a repo plus an optional note. Empty list means no repos are protected.
